# Code samples

## Indentation

Follow the style guide for the language: spaces instead of tabs, two spaces per indentation level in most cases. Some contexts use four spaces or tabs. This applies to code blocks, not command-line syntax.

## Line length

**Wrap lines at 80 characters.** For narrower browser windows or print, consider wrapping shorter.

## Preformatted text

`pre` in HTML. In Markdown, indent every line of the code block by four spaces.

## Omissions

Show omitted code with a **comment in the language's syntax**. Don't use three dots or an ellipsis character. A code block with an omission should not be click-to-copy.

## Introducing code samples

Precede with an introductory sentence or paragraph.

- **Colon** when the intro immediately precedes the sample.
- **Period** when other material (a note, a link) sits between, or when the intro covers unrelated content.

## Style references

Defer to the applicable public coding style guide for the language. Some projects maintain their own overriding conventions.
